info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Jobs-v5-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the list of job applications within the Careers section. It enables users to query available job postings, allowing potential candidates to explore employment opportunities that match their skills and interests. Typical consumers include job seekers and recruitment platforms looking to integrate job listings into their systems. The API is designed to facilitate an efficient browsing experience for candidates seeking their next career move.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of job applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all job applications that have been submitted. It supports filtering and pagination options to help users find specific applications efficiently.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving a list of job applications. This body contains filters or specific parameters to tailor the request for job listings, ensuring that the response aligns with user needs.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of job applications.
